units.source_text: 八亲王入山念佛，原定今日圆满。

en.t: Prince Hachi had gone into the mountains to recite prayers, and his retreat was originally to be completed today.

units.source_text: 两位女公子时刻盼待，巴不得他早点回家。

en.t: The two young ladies waited for him every moment, longing for him to come home as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 直到傍晚，山中使者来了，传达八亲王的话道：“今天早起身体不好，不能返家。

en.t: Not until evening did a messenger come from the mountain, bringing Prince Hachi's words: "I felt unwell from early this morning and cannot return home.

units.source_text: 想是感受风寒，正在设法治疗。

en.t: I think I may have caught a chill, and measures are being taken to treat it.

units.source_text: 但不知何故，似比往时更加担心，深恐不能再见。”

en.t: Yet for some reason I feel more anxious than usual, and I greatly fear that we may not meet again."

units.source_text: 两女公子大吃一惊，不知病状究竟如何，不胜忧虑。

en.t: The two young ladies were greatly startled, and not knowing the true state of his illness, they were overcome with worry.

units.source_text: 连忙将父亲的衣服添加很厚的棉絮，交使者送去。

en.t: They hurriedly added thick cotton padding to their father's clothes and gave them to the messenger to take back.

units.source_text: 此后二三日，八亲王一直不下山。

en.t: For the next two or three days, Prince Hachi still did not come down from the mountain.

units.source_text: 两位女公子屡次遣使去问病状，八亲王叫人口头传言，说“并无特别重症，只是浑身不适。

en.t: The two young ladies repeatedly sent messengers to ask about his condition, and Prince Hachi had someone reply orally, saying, "It is nothing especially serious; I simply feel unwell all over.

units.source_text: 倘能略见好转，当即抱病下山”。

en.t: If I improve even a little, I will come down the mountain at once, ill though I am."

units.source_text: 阿阇梨日夜在旁看护，对他说道：“这病表面看来无关紧要，但或许是大限来到。

en.t: The Acharya stayed by his side day and night nursing him, and said, "This illness may seem trivial on the surface, but perhaps your allotted time has come.

units.source_text: 切不可为女公子之事忧虑！

en.t: You must not worry about the young ladies.

units.source_text: 凡人宿命各不相同，故不须将此事挂在心头。”

en.t: Every person's destiny is different, so you need not keep this matter on your mind."

units.source_text: 就逐渐开导他舍弃一切世俗之事，又谏阻他：“如今更不可下山了。”

en.t: He gradually guided him to abandon all worldly concerns, and further admonished him, "Now more than ever, you must not go down the mountain."

units.source_text: 此乃八月二十日之事。

en.t: This took place on the twentieth day of the eighth month.

units.source_text: 是日天色特别凄凉。

en.t: The sky that day was especially desolate.

units.source_text: 两女公子忧虑父亲的病，心中犹如蒙着昼夜不散的浓雾。

en.t: The two young ladies worried over their father's illness, their hearts as if shrouded in a dense fog that would not lift by day or night.

units.source_text: 残月皎然地破云而出，照得水面明澄如镜。

en.t: The waning moon broke brightly through the clouds, lighting the water until it shone clear as a mirror.

units.source_text: 女公子命人打开向着山寺的板窗，对着这边凝望。

en.t: The young ladies had someone open the shutters facing the mountain temple and gazed intently in that direction.

units.source_text: 不久山寺的钟声隐隐响出，可知天已亮了。

en.t: Before long, the bell of the mountain temple sounded faintly, and they knew that dawn had come.

units.source_text: 此时山上派人来了，其人啼啼哭哭地说：“亲王已于夜半时分亡故。”

en.t: At that moment someone sent from the mountain arrived, weeping as he said, "The Prince passed away around midnight."

units.source_text: 日来两女公子时刻挂念，不断地担心病状如何，此时突然闻此消息，惊惶之余，竟致昏迷不醒。

en.t: For days the two young ladies had been constantly anxious, always worrying about his condition; when they suddenly heard this news, they were so shocked and terrified that they fainted and could not be revived.

units.source_text: 悲伤过度，眼泪反不知到哪里去了，只管俯伏在地上。

en.t: Their grief was so extreme that their tears seemed to have vanished, and they only lay prostrate on the ground.

units.source_text: 死别之事，倘是亲眼目睹，则心无遗憾，此乃世之常例。

en.t: When parting from someone in death, if one sees it with one's own eyes, the heart is left without regret; such is the ordinary way of the world.

units.source_text: 但两位女公子不得送终，因此倍觉悲伤。

en.t: But the two young ladies had not been able to attend his final moments, and so their grief was all the greater.

units.source_text: 她们心中常想：如果父亲死去，她们一刻也不能生存于世。

en.t: They had often thought in their hearts that if their father died, they could not live in this world for even a moment.

units.source_text: 故此时悲恸号泣，只想追随同行。

en.t: Thus now they wailed in bitter grief, wanting only to follow him and go with him.

units.source_text: 然而人寿修短有定，毕竟无可奈何。

en.t: Yet the length of a person's life is fixed, and in the end nothing can be done.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨年来早受八亲王嘱托，故身后应有法事，由他一力承办。

en.t: The Acharya had long ago received Prince Hachi's instructions, so he took full responsibility for the rites that were to be performed after his death.

units.source_text: 两女公子向他要求：“亡父遗容，我等总想再见一次。”

en.t: The two young ladies pleaded with him, "We still wish to see our late father's face once more."

units.source_text: 阿阇梨的答复只是这几句话：“现在岂可再见？

en.t: The Acharya's reply consisted only of these few words: "How could you see him again now?

units.source_text: 亲王在世之日，早已言定不再与女公子见面。

en.t: While the Prince was still alive, he had already declared that he would no longer meet the young ladies.

units.source_text: 如今身亡，更不必说了。

en.t: Now that he has passed away, there is even less need to speak of it.

units.source_text: 你们应该快快断念，务求习惯此种心境。”

en.t: You should quickly give up the thought and strive to accustom yourselves to this state of mind."

units.source_text: 女公子探询父亲在山时情状，但这阿阇梨道心过分坚强，认为琐屑可厌。

en.t: The young ladies asked about how their father had been while on the mountain, but this Acharya's religious resolve was so stern that he regarded such details as tedious and distasteful.

units.source_text: 八亲王自昔就深怀出家之志，只因两女儿无人代他照拂，难于离去，故生前一直和她们朝夕相依，赖此慰藉孤寂的生涯。

en.t: Prince Hachi had long cherished a deep desire to take religious vows, but because there was no one to care for his two daughters in his place, he found it hard to leave them; while alive he therefore remained with them morning and evening, taking this as comfort in his lonely life.

units.source_text: 终于受其羁绊，不离尘俗地过了一生。

en.t: In the end, bound by that attachment, he spent his whole life without leaving the secular world.

units.source_text: 如今走上了死别的旅途，则先死者的悲哀和后死者的恋念，都是无可奈何的了。

en.t: Now that he had set out on the journey of parting in death, both the sorrow of the one who died first and the longing of those left behind were beyond remedy.
